# 5Ghost WiFi Lab

Companion app for the 5Ghost BW16 module on the Flipper Zero GPIO header. It is an open-source host app for authorized dual-band 2.4/5 GHz Wi-Fi security testing on networks you own or have permission to test.

The Flipper app talks to the module over UART. Full functionality requires the 5Ghost BW16 hardware connected and powered.

## Hardware

- Flipper Zero
- 5Ghost BW16 GPIO module

## Source and setup

https://github.com/pingequalab/5ghost-wifi-lab

Use only on equipment and networks you are authorized to test.
